blocking_findings.summary: SCIENTIFIC/PRELIMINARY classification counts all source rows instead of eligible out-of-sample walk-forward forecasts.
blocking_findings.contract: .codex/contracts/monthly-backtest-contract.md:28 requires PRELIMINARY unless the report has at least 10 tickers, 60 monthly cutoffs, and 500 eligible out-of-sample forecasts after coverage rules.
blocking_findings.evidence: evaluation/point_in_time_dataset.py:214-220 determines report_level before folds exist and uses len(ordered) >= 500. evaluation/monthly_backtest.py:344 correctly computes forecast_count_per_variant after observable-outcome fold construction, but line 358 copies the earlier dataset classification unchanged. An independent in-memory counterexample with 10 tickers and 60 cutoffs produced dataset_rows=600, dataset_level=SCIENTIFIC, fold_count=23, and only 230 eligible out-of-sample forecasts per variant.
blocking_findings.impact: A report below the frozen 500-out-of-sample threshold can be labeled SCIENTIFIC. This is an unversioned deviation from the monthly-backtest contract and can overstate scientific readiness even though the locked two-ticker fixture is correctly labeled PRELIMINARY.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The locked regression fixture remains honestly PRELIMINARY and discloses Full Model underperformance.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: For the current 2-ticker, 48-cutoff fixture, all artifacts consistently report 11 expanding observable-outcome folds, 22 forecasts per variant, 154 variant records, zero future records, no investment interpretation, and Full Model underperformance versus no-Financial on MAE and versus market-only/no-Graph/no-Sentiment on mean net excess return. The blocker concerns the general threshold gate, not the current fixture's reported metrics.

required_rework.requirement: Derive scientific_report_level only after walk-forward eligibility and coverage are known. Require ticker_count >= 10, monthly_cutoff_count >= 60, and eligible out-of-sample forecast count per common variant row set >= 500; otherwise force PRELIMINARY. Record the actual OOS count and threshold inputs in the reproducibility manifest.
required_rework.test_requirement: Add a deterministic boundary/counterexample test proving that 10 tickers and 60 cutoffs with fewer than 500 eligible OOS forecasts remains PRELIMINARY, plus boundary tests for 499 versus 500 eligible OOS forecasts after coverage rules. Preserve identical eligible rows across all seven variants and the current fixture report hash unless a versioned scientific contract change explicitly requires otherwise.
